description: Hash EIP-712 typed data (typed_data as JSON text, as passed to eth_signTypedData_v4): encoded type, domain separator, struct hash and digest. With an existing public signature (65-byte or EIP-2098 64-byte) it recovers the signer address and low_s flag; with signer it reports valid or signer_mismatch. Checks existing signatures only; never signs. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: typed_data_verify
title: EIP-712 typed data hash / signer check (dev tool)
